# Exploding Variables and Dice

Cap a die at its highest roll, on any weapon your monsters, items and spells use, and on the dice of any summoning ritual. A vanilla die that lands on its highest face rolls again and adds the new roll. With `noexplode`, a die stops there, so `1d6` gives 1 to 6.

### noexplode [parts | start | end] <span class="new-badge">New</span> { #noexplode .command data-toc-label="noexplode" data-added="2.8" }

Caps the damage die of the weapon whose block it's in, after `newweapon` or `selectweapon`. A spell, a monster's attack and a magic item get it through their weapon. Under a ritual's `addstring`, it caps the dice in that string, for `summoning` and `farsummon`. A `clearwspec` below it takes it off a weapon.

<!-- vale CoE5SE.Reports = NO -->
- **parts:** Parts of the string above, by number, counted from 1 at each ` & `. Name more than one with spaces: `noexplode 1 3`. With no number, no die in the string explodes. A part needs dice (`2d6*Wight` has them, `c*Mound King` doesn't). A part without dice, or a number past the last part, makes the line change nothing (logged in `coe5mod.log`).
<!-- vale CoE5SE.Reports = YES -->
- **start**, **end:** `noexplode start` covers every weapon and every `addstring` down to the `noexplode end` line. It skips the weapon whose block it sits in, so put it above the first `newweapon` or `selectweapon` it's for. Without an `end`, it runs to the end of your mod's files. Inside a range, `clearwspec` doesn't last, as the next line puts `noexplode` back. To leave a weapon out, put `noexplode end` above its block and `noexplode start` inside it.

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    noexplode
    ```

    Or one part of the string above, while the others still explode:

    ```c5se
    noexplode 1
    ```

    Or every weapon and summoning string between two lines:

    ```c5se
    noexplode start
    noexplode end
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@noexplode
    ```

    Or one part of the string above, while the others still explode:

    ```c5m
    #!@noexplode 1
    ```

    Or every weapon and summoning string between two lines:

    ```c5m
    #!@noexplode start
    #!@noexplode end
    ```

<!-- vale CoE5SE.Reports = NO -->
!!! warning "Put it right under its addstring"
    Each `noexplode` under a ritual changes the last `addstring` above it in that block, so put one right under each string it's for. With no `addstring` above it in the block, it changes nothing (logged in `coe5mod.log`), even on a vanilla ritual with its own string, and your players' summons still explode.
<!-- vale CoE5SE.Reports = YES -->

!!! tip "For players without CoE5SE"
    In the .c5m, the vanilla game skips the `#!@` line, so those dice still explode.

## Examples { #examples }

### A new weapon { #example-weapon }

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    newweapon "Morgul Blade"
    dmg 6
    noexplode
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    newweapon "Morgul Blade"
    dmg 6
    #!@noexplode
    ```

### A vanilla weapon { #example-vanilla-weapon }

Every monster with the weapon gets it. This one is on 145 of the game's monsters.

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    selectweapon "Bite"
    noexplode
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    selectweapon "Bite"
    #!@noexplode
    ```

### A monster's attack { #example-monster }

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    newweapon "Sting of Shelob"
    noexplode

    newmonster "Shelob"
    copystats "Giant Spider"
    copyspr "Giant Spider"
    clearweapons
    meleeweapon 18 "Sting of Shelob"
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    newweapon "Sting of Shelob"
    #!@noexplode

    newmonster "Shelob"
    copystats "Giant Spider"
    copyspr "Giant Spider"
    clearweapons
    meleeweapon 18 "Sting of Shelob"
    ```

### A magic item { #example-item }

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    newweapon "Anduril"
    dmg 12
    noexplode

    newitem "Flame of the West"
    type 1
    itemwep "Anduril"
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    newweapon "Anduril"
    dmg 12
    #!@noexplode

    newitem "Flame of the West"
    type 1
    itemwep "Anduril"
    ```

### A spell { #example-spell }

The spell's number sets the die, and the weapon carries `noexplode`.

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    newweapon "Whip of Udun"
    noexplode

    newspell "Wrath of the Balrog"
    path "Pyromancy"
    level 3
    weapon 30 "Whip of Udun"
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    newweapon "Whip of Udun"
    #!@noexplode

    #!@newspell "Wrath of the Balrog"
    #!@path "Pyromancy"
    #!@level 3
    #!@weapon 30 "Whip of Udun"
    ```

### A summoning ritual { #example-summoning }

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    newritual "Muster of the Dead"
    descr "The Witch-king raises a measured host."
    level 3
    summoning
    addstring "3d6*Soulless"
    noexplode
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    newritual "Muster of the Dead"
    descr "The Witch-king raises a measured host."
    level 3
    summoning
    addstring "3d6*Soulless"
    #!@noexplode
    ```

### One part of a summon string { #example-part }

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    newritual "Barrow Summons"
    descr "The Witch-king calls up the dead of the Barrow-downs."
    level 1
    summoning
    addstring "1d3+2*Wight & 3d6*Soulless"
    noexplode 1
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    newritual "Barrow Summons"
    descr "The Witch-king calls up the dead of the Barrow-downs."
    level 1
    summoning
    addstring "1d3+2*Wight & 3d6*Soulless"
    #!@noexplode 1
    ```

### One string of several { #example-strings }

Each `addstring` keeps its own rule, so one roll of this ritual can stay capped and the other can explode.

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    newritual "Horn of Dunharrow"
    descr "Sometimes a measured company answers, sometimes the whole mountain."
    level 4
    summoning
    addstring "2d6*Longdead"
    noexplode
    addstring "2d6*Soulless"
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    newritual "Horn of Dunharrow"
    descr "Sometimes a measured company answers, sometimes the whole mountain."
    level 4
    summoning
    addstring "2d6*Longdead"
    #!@noexplode
    addstring "2d6*Soulless"
    ```

### A whole armory { #example-range }

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    noexplode start
    newweapon "Blade of Gondolin"
    dmg 8

    newweapon "Spear of Gil-galad"
    dmg 10

    newritual "Host of the Last Alliance"
    descr "Every blade and every banner, counted to the last."
    level 6
    summoning
    addstring "2d6*Wight"
    noexplode end
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@noexplode start
    newweapon "Blade of Gondolin"
    dmg 8

    newweapon "Spear of Gil-galad"
    dmg 10

    newritual "Host of the Last Alliance"
    descr "Every blade and every banner, counted to the last."
    level 6
    summoning
    addstring "2d6*Wight"
    #!@noexplode end
    ```
